does: Spreads a thick sweet and sharp sauce over meat that has partly baked, and bakes it on until it turns sticky and dark at the edges.
how: Stir the glaze together until the sugar is mixed through.
Bake the meat first, so that the glaze goes on for the last part only.
Spread or brush the glaze over the top and sides.
Return it to the oven until the glaze is sticky and dark at the edges.

cues.text: A shiny, sticky glaze, darker at the edges but not black.
Caramel and tomato, with no burnt smell.

mistakes.mistake: Putting the glaze on at the start, so that the sugar burns before the meat is done.
mistakes.fix: Add it for the last part of the baking only.

mistakes.mistake: Spreading it too thick, so that it stays wet.

comes_after.why: A glaze is spread on a shaped loaf.

variant_of.differs: A thick sweet sauce is spread over meat in the oven and baked on until sticky, rather than small vegetables cooked on the hob in butter, sugar and water until coated.
